fields.summary: Billing address must be validated before payment authorisation
fields.description: As a Customer, I want the billing address checked before my card is charged so that failed payments do not leave orders in a broken state.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Given a basket with at least one item, when the customer submits the payment form without a billing address, then submission is blocked with a field-level validation message.

fields.summary: Standard users must not reach admin routes
fields.description: Route-level authorisation is currently client-side only.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Given a standard-role user, when they navigate directly to /admin, then they receive an access-denied response and no administrative data is rendered.

fields.description: The reporting screen should be faster and handle large date ranges appropriately. Users have complained.
